summary: HCA Inc., a subsidiary of HCA Healthcare, Inc., filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $3.0 billion offering of senior notes in three tranches: $1.0B 4.700% notes due 2031, $750M 5.000% notes due 2033, and $1.25B 5.300% notes due 2036. Proceeds will redeem $2.5B of outstanding 2026 notes and for general corporate purposes. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by HCA Healthcare. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. There is no event-driven angle; the filing is a standard corporate debt issuance.
